newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee slips on dollar speculation.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee slips on dollar speculation.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed a shade lower against the dollar on Monday in thin trade which was led by speculation, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.63 to the dollar, after opening at 57.58. The rupee closed at 57.55 on Friday.
"The rupee slipped on speculative (dollar) buying since commercial demand was insignificant," said a Standard Chartered Bank dealer.
Overnight call rates closed at 12.5 percent after opening at 14 percent, with the market well offered, dealers said.
"There were more lenders than borrowers towards the end of the day," said one. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
